day_shape: 102 items: Iran suspends US backchannel over Israeli strikes in Lebanon, CENTCOM intercepts two Iranian ballistic missiles aimed at Kuwait, IDF withdraws 146th Division from south Lebanon, IRGC's Qaani threatens Bab el-Mandeb closure, and Iran executes two over January mosque-burning.

threads.label: Iran suspends US talks over Lebanon
threads.summary: Tasnim reported Iran has halted its message exchange with Washington citing Israeli strikes in Lebanon, with Trump telling reporters he had not heard of any suspension and arguing 'going silent' could aid talks. Jerusalem Post separately reported Iran is pushing for a limited interim deal to ease economic pressure without major nuclear concessions.

threads.label: South Lebanon combat and 146th Division pullout
threads.summary: The IDF said Capt. Dr. Ori Yosef Silvester of Givati's Shaked Battalion was killed and seven troops wounded in a Hezbollah explosive drone attack, and announced the 146th Division had completed three months in southern Lebanon. The military said the division eliminated 550+ militants and dismantled 2,700+ infrastructure sites, leaving the 91st and 36th divisions in place.

threads.label: Hezbollah rocket and drone fire, Beirut evacuation warning
threads.summary: Hezbollah launched rockets at Kiryat Shmona and Karmiel and FPV drones at Rosh Hanikra and Metula, while IDF Arabic spokesman Avichay Adraee issued evacuation warnings for Dahiyeh in southern Beirut. Defa Press's Khatam al-Anbiya HQ warned northern Israeli settlements would be targeted if Netanyahu carried out threats to bomb Beirut.

threads.label: CENTCOM blockade and Kuwait missile intercept
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US forces intercepted two Iranian ballistic missiles targeting American forces in Kuwait at 11pm ET with no casualties, and reported the ongoing US blockade against Iran has redirected 121 commercial vessels and disabled 5. UKMTO also reported an explosion incident involving a cargo ship 40 nautical miles southeast of Umm Qasr, Iraq.

threads.label: IRGC Hormuz/Bab el-Mandeb posture
threads.summary: Defa Press carried a message from IRGC Quds Force commander Esmail Qaani saying the resistance axis would work to 'equalise' traffic conditions in the Bab el-Mandeb with the Strait of Hormuz, and IRGC intelligence warned of opening new fronts. IRIB's Persian Gulf Waterway Management body claimed 300+ non-Iranian vessels, mostly tankers, had submitted data to seek Hormuz transit permits since Ordibehesht.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging and Iranian executions
threads.summary: Khamenei's office circulated statements from MPs endorsing the Supreme Leader's recent message and framing Esfand 1404 as the start of a 'new era of Iranian power,' alongside IRIB coverage of night 93 of Azadi Square gatherings. Jerusalem Post reported Iran executed two men accused of burning a mosque during January protests, citing Mizan news agency.

threads.label: Gaza disarmament track and Hamas targeting
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Jamal Abu Aoun, a Hamas company commander who also worked as a doctor at Al-Yafa Hospital in Deir al-Balah, in a weekend strike. Times of Israel reported Gaza mediators will resume Hamas disarmament talks in Egypt, with Jerusalem Post naming four candidates positioned to take over Hamas in Gaza.

The Golani soldiers had directed the IAF strike, the military says.

events.title: An IDF soldier was killed and three others were wounded in a Hezbollah drone attack in southern Lebanon overnight, the military announces. The slain soldier is named as Staff Sgt. Adam Tzarfati, 20, of the Commando Brigade's Maglan Unit, from Rosh Haayin. At around 1 a.m., a explosive-laden first-person view drone launched by Hezbollah struck a site in the southern Lebanon town of Yohmor, near the Beaufort Castle, where Israeli troops were operating. The blast killed Tzarfati and wounded another soldier seriously. Two other troops were lightly hurt in the attack, the army says. The wounded soldiers were airlifted to a hospital and their families were notified, the IDF adds.
